questions.text: What area of your life needs healing the most - physical, emotional, or spiritual?
questions.verse_text: Heal me, O LORD, and I shall be healed; save me, and I shall be saved: for thou art my praise.

questions.text: Is there a wound you've been carrying for a long time?
questions.verse_text: He healeth the broken in heart, and bindeth up their wounds.

questions.text: Do you believe God wants to heal you?
questions.verse_text: Beloved, I wish above all things that thou mayest prosper and be in health, even as thy soul prospereth.

questions.text: What would your life look like if you were completely healed?
questions.verse_text: But he was wounded for our transgressions, he was bruised for our iniquities: the chastisement of our peace was upon him; and with his stripes we are healed.

questions.text: Have you ever experienced God's healing touch?
questions.verse_text: And he said unto her, Daughter, thy faith hath made thee whole; go in peace, and be whole of thy plague.

questions.text: Is there something you need to release in order to receive healing?
questions.verse_text: When Jesus saw their faith, he said unto the sick of the palsy, Son, thy sins be forgiven thee.

questions.text: How do you feel about the timing of God's healing?
questions.verse_text: A time to kill, and a time to heal; a time to break down, and a time to build up.

questions.text: What if healing looks different than you expected?
questions.verse_text: For which cause we faint not; but though our outward man perish, yet the inward man is renewed day by day.

questions.text: Is there someone you need to forgive as part of your healing journey?
questions.verse_text: Confess your faults one to another, and pray one for another, that ye may be healed. The effectual fervent prayer of a righteous man availeth much.

questions.text: Would you like to bring your need for healing to God together right now?
questions.verse_text: Bless the LORD, O my soul, and forget not all his benefits: Who forgiveth all thine iniquities; who healeth all thy diseases.
